antenna.label: Antenna
antenna.role: Collects the satellite's 437 MHz signal and radiates the uplink. Circular polarisation means the satellite's tumble doesn't fade the link.

split.label: TX antenna
split.role: Transmit-only Yagi. Carries the +30 dBm uplink, so nothing sensitive sits on its feedline. It has not yet closed an uplink at Borrego.

antenna_rx.label: RX antenna
antenna_rx.role: Receive-only Yagi on the same cross-boom: longer and higher gain than the TX antenna, because the downlink is the weak direction. Feeds the LNA through a short jumper, with no T/R relay in the path.

lna.label: Mast LNA
lna.role: Amplifies the weak downlink before cable loss eats it. Must be switched out before transmit or the uplink destroys it.

split.role: Sits permanently in the RX line at the mast. Powered by its own 12 V line from the shack, not over the coax. The uplink leaves through the other antenna, so no sequencer is needed. Open question: is the TX antenna far enough away not to overload it?

rotator.label: Rotator
rotator.role: Physically points the antenna along the pass. Tracking error costs dB; this is what keeps a 13 dBi beam on target. The end-mounted Yagi hangs off an aluminium tube boom in the elevation clamp.

split.role: One rotator turns both antennas together on a fiberglass cross-boom, so the two chains always point at the same place. Fiberglass, because M2's manuals call for a non-conductive cross-boom so metal stays out of the antennas' near field. Borrego center-mounts both Yagis on it.

mount.label: Roof mount
mount.role: Holds mast, rotator and antenna against wind. A civil decision per site, not a catalogue part.

tinygs.label: TinyGS node
tinygs.role: A separate cheap receiver with its own antenna. Reports to TinyGS, a second witness that the satellite is alive. Not in the GDS chain.

coax.label: Coax
coax.role: Carries RF between roof and shack in two runs: antenna to arrestor, then arrestor to the shack. Its ~2.7 dB loss per 100 ft is the biggest passive loss in the link budget.

coax_rx.label: RX coax
coax_rx.role: Receive feedline, LNA to arrestor to shack. Behind the LNA, so its loss matters far less to the link budget.

arrestor.label: Lightning arrestor
arrestor.role: Shunts surges to ground where the coax enters the building, so a strike on the mast doesn't reach the radio or the Pi. N female on both sides, so both feedline runs end in N male.

arrestor_rx.label: RX arrestor
arrestor_rx.role: Same surge protection on the second run. Every cable entering the building gets one. It blocks DC, which is fine because the LNA has its own 12 V line.

adapter.label: N→SMA adapter
adapter.role: Bridges the feedline's N connector to the GRC's SMA port.

adapter_rx.label: RX N→SMA
adapter_rx.role: Bridges the RX feedline to the RX GRC.

swr.label: SWR meter
swr.role: Inserted inline once at commissioning to prove the GRC puts out ~1 W and the antenna is matched. It takes the shack run directly, and an N-to-SMA jumper replaces the adapter into the GRC. Removed afterwards.

grc.label: GRC
grc.role: Ground Radio Controller: the LoRa transceiver (SX1268, +30 dBm). Frames go to and from the Pi over USB serial. The only part with no commercial equivalent.

split.label: TX GRC
split.role: Transmits only. Takes commands from the Pi over USB and puts +30 dBm on the TX antenna.

grc_rx.label: RX GRC
grc_rx.role: Receives only. Never transmits, so a Radio Stick V1 is acceptable here. Decoded frames go to the Pi over USB.

sequencer.label: Sequencer
sequencer.role: Keyed from the GRC's TX_EN, it switches the LNA out at least 20 ms before RF leaves the radio.

usb.label: USB cable
usb.role: Serial link and power for the GRC. A charge-only cable is the classic 'radio never enumerates' failure.

pi.label: Raspberry Pi
pi.role: Runs tracking (rotator commands), the GDS and the mission pack. NTP time sync is a hard requirement: bad time means bad pointing.

rotctl.label: Rotator interface
rotctl.role: Translates GS-232B commands from the Pi (hamlib model 603) into drive for the rotator's controller.

bench.label: Bench loopback
bench.role: Commissioning only: a second GRC behind 30 dB of pads proves a frame decodes without anything on the roof.

split.role: Commissioning only: the TX GRC loops back to the RX GRC through 30 dB of pads. The station already owns both radios.
